key_insight: SP-HQAOA combines hierarchical decomposition with symmetry-preserving contraction to optimize problems larger than the qubit limit using shallow quantum circuits.
engineering_relevance: The approach separates subproblem size from per-circuit qubit requirements, enabling larger optimization workloads under constrained quantum hardware resources.
method: Divide the problem into a recursive hierarchy of subproblems.
Contract parity sectors while preserving the zero-field Ising objective, allowing leaf blocks larger than the circuit qubit limit.
Bound potential optimal-value loss from sector restrictions and sum bounds across contraction steps and hierarchy levels.
evidence_signal: At depth p=1, the abstract reports 99.4–99.7% of the exact optimum on N=40 random regular MaxCut leaf blocks and 96% of a classical reference for N=500 using at most 10 qubits per circuit.
watch_item: Sector restrictions can sacrifice solution quality, and the reported benchmarks do not establish practical quantum advantage on noisy hardware.
paper_title: Symmetry-Preserving Hierarchical Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm with Subproblems Beyond the Qubit Limit
